_note: v2.7 plan 36 (NOT YET RUN; batched into plan 39): the Journal, the Stat sheet and a public dice chip in player mode, with a hidden quest, an author note and an unearned secret milestone that must not reach any player surface. No model call: every write is a /cp set boundary.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The ferryman wants his coin.

steps.eval: const snap = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const titles = (snap.game?.quests ?? []).map((quest) => quest.title); if (JSON.stringify(titles) !== JSON.stringify(["The ferryman's debt"])) throw new Error('player quests: ' + JSON.stringify(titles)); return { titles, sheet: snap.game?.sheet };

const rows = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.extras.checks?.records ?? []; if (rows.length !== 1 || rows[0].checkId !== 'climb') throw new Error('check records: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); return rows.map((row) => row.outcome);

const opener = document.querySelector('#so-open-journal'); if (!opener) throw new Error('no journal opener (#so-open-journal)'); if (opener.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') opener.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); const text = document.querySelector('#so-journal')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!text.includes("The ferryman's debt") || !text.includes('A helping hand')) throw new Error('journal: ' + text.slice(0, 300)); for (const leak of ['SO-HIDDEN-QUEST-TITLE', 'SO-HIDDEN-STEP', 'SO-AUTHOR-NOTE', 'SO-SECRET-MILESTONE']) if (document.body.textContent.includes(leak)) throw new Error('leak: ' + leak); document.querySelector('#so-panel-journal [data-so="panel-close"]')?.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); if (document.querySelector('#so-panel-journal')) throw new Error('the journal panel did not close, so it would cover the drawer tabs and outlive the run'); return true;

const read = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#chat [data-so="roll-chip"]')].map((chip) => chip.getAttribute('data-source')); let chips = read(); for (let i = 0; i < 25 && !chips.length; i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200)); chips = read(); } if (!chips.length) throw new Error('no dice chip in the chat: the public climb check should show one under the message it decided'); if (chips.some((source) => source !== 'check')) throw new Error('author chips in player mode: ' + chips); return chips;
